said.text: My Consumer Debt Uniformity Act does a simple thing: extend existing protections to all types of debt cases. That means less confusion and stronger protections for all New Yorkers.

did.text: Voted Yes on S9760, which extends consumer-credit case protections to all consumer debt cases, including medical debt, rent arrears, and tuition debt. Passed Senate 43–18.

whyNote: The statement, issued the day of the vote, describes the same bill the vote passed. Sen. Gounardes is the bill's sponsor and voted yes.
